verdict.rationale: Cline's agentic design (tool use, subagents that spawn parallel research agents, autonomous file/command execution) supports exploring a codebase without manual file selection, and one hands-on report describes setting it loose on a whole codebase with strong results [cline-docs-8][cline-comm-3]. But another first-hand comment explicitly contradicts the claim that Cline doesn't need codebase indexing, calling this 'a major feature' it is missing, i.e. its ability to map/understand an unfamiliar codebase autonomously is disputed by users [cline-comm-2]. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a dedicated 'codebase mapping/indexing' feature, and independent benchmarks confirming whole-repo comprehension without manual context selection.
